claims.claim_text: Stair st-0 is drawn outside both wing outlines on both plans and climbs 4.5 m between lv-down-450 and lv-entry, while the night wing is drawn 3.0 m tall: the flight passes the night wing's roof slab slab-roof-down-450, so it cannot be walked as drawn.

In the true section the night wing floor slab-floor-down-450 hangs several metres above the terrain line, and the day wing also stands clear of the ground: both wings sit on large unsupported voids rather than stepping down the slope.
The living room sp-living is drawn as the smallest day room, well below the program target for pi-living; the dining room next to it is about as large.
On the lower level the labels of the child bedrooms, the corridor sp-corridor-b1 and the plant room sp-mechanical overlap and cannot be read at the default zoom.
